This market will resolve to "Yes" if MicroStrategy sells any of its Bitcoin by 11:59 PM ET on the date specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from MSTR and on-chain data, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

findings: F1. The rules written at creation (on-chain ancillary data, 2026-05-05) make Yes depend on a sale happening by the deadline; they do not say whether evidence published after the deadline counts.
F2. Strategy's own 8-K (EDGAR accepted 2026-06-01 12:00:16Z) reports 32 BTC sold during May 26-31, 2026, i.e. inside the window; the disclosure itself came ~8 h after the deadline.
F3. Both 'No' proposals were disputed before the 8-K was public (04:12Z and 04:53Z), so the case went to the UMA DVM.

F4. The clause 'Confirmation achieved outside of the market's time frame does not qualify' first appears on-chain at 2026-06-01T17:00:16Z: 13.0 h after the deadline, 5.0 h after the 8-K and after both disputes.
F5. The UMA DVM resolved No with 98.61% of revealed tokens (607 reveals, 19.43M UMA); the market settled No on 2026-06-04T00:34:19Z.
F6. Two sibling markets of the same event (June 30, Dec 31) resolved Yes on the same sale.

F7. YES traded 11.6c at the deadline and 11.6c at 11:50Z, peaked at 81.2c at 12:20Z (20 min after the 8-K), traded 55.3c just before the clarification and 0.05c ten minutes after it (CLOB price history, 10-min points).

F8. Both bulletin updates were posted from a Polymarket operator account other than the question's initializer; the adapter's bulletin-board getter for the initializer returns no updates for this question.
